explanation: Repeat exactly 32 times: shift the result left, append the current low input bit, and shift the input right. Leading zeros are included.
timeComplexity: O(32), constant time for the fixed-width input. The loop executes exactly 32 fixed-cost rounds.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space. Only the result, remaining input, and loop count are retained.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C# implementation, reusing and refining the repository-authored Blind75 algorithm fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
correctness: After i rounds, result holds the reverse of the lowest i original bits. Shifting result and appending the next low bit preserves this invariant. Exactly 32 rounds include all leading zeros and produce the required unsigned 32-bit reversal.
walkthrough: For n=3, original bits 0 and 1 are set. Reversing 32 positions moves them to bits 31 and 30, giving 0xC0000000, or unsigned value 3221225472. Return that value in a long.
edgeCases: Exactly 32 bits are reversed, not all 64 bits of the carrier type.
The result is nonnegative in the range 0..2^32-1.
